assumptions.statement: Submitted site boundary (PROV-SITE-001) and all three key-area polygons (PROV-KEY-001/002/003) are provisional rough constraints with official_boundary=false. All geometry layers, metrics, figures, PDFs and HTML are generated from them and must be fully recomputed when official polygons are published.
assumptions.impact: Package passes intake self-check and remains eligible for content scoring; not usable as official redline, approval basis, or precise-area evidence.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls (FAR, building height, density, setbacks, road redlines), land ownership, municipal utilities, and heritage constraints are missing from the public site package (planning_limits.json).
assumptions.impact: FAR and total floor area are declared unknown in metrics.json; all retain/renovate/demolish/new-build content is method illustration only, not parcel-level conclusions.

assumptions.statement: All known metrics are recomputed from geometry in EPSG:4548. Land-use partition is topology-cleaned in projected space (1cm snap grid): pairwise overlap < 1 sqm, coverage gap 22 sqm < allowed tolerance.
assumptions.impact: Metrics.json values, figure numbers, visual/index.html data-metric values and proposal.md statements are consistent and independently recomputable.

assumptions.statement: Event system, developer community operation, scenario-open mechanism and conversion pathways are mechanism-design suggestions, not confirmed government activities, investment, or policy commitments.
assumptions.impact: No operational claims may be cited as approved arrangements.
